source: This notebook takes a Spark Temp Table and a few parameters and dynamically updates a Fact in the Serverless SQL database (Gold layer).

# Example Parameters:
databaseName = 'gold'
schemaName = "Fact"
tableName = "Transaction"
surrogateKey = "SK_Transaction"
naturalKeyColumnList = ["TransactionId"]
isIncrementalLoad = True
incrementalColumn = "ModifyDate"

# Setup for Max Date variable.  
df_etl = spark.sql(f"SELECT max(ModifyDate) as MaxDate FROM {databasename}.{schemaName}{tableName}")
maxDate = df_etl.collect()[0].MaxDate

print(sqlQuery)
print(maxDate)

sparkTableName = f"{schemaName}_{tableName}"
print("SparkTableName: ", sparkTableName)

if "maxDate" not in locals() and "maxDate" not in globals():
    maxDate = '1900-01-01'

# Assign additional variables
targetContainer = 'fs-analyticsdev'
#storageAccountName = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecretWithLS("ls_keyvault", "kv-datalake-storage-account-name")
storageAccountName = "dlsdccanalyticsdev"
targetDirectory = f'{databaseName}/{schemaName}/{tableName}'
targetTableFullPath = 'abfss://' + targetContainer + "@" + storageAccountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + targetDirectory
metadataColumns = ["ETLRowValueHash", "ETLKeyHash", "ETLRowInsertedDatetime", "ETLRowUpdatedDatetime"]
metadataColumns.extend(naturalKeyColumnList)
fullTableName = schemaName + '_' + tableName
stagingTableName = 'staging_' + schemaName + tableName

print("TargetDirectory: ", targetDirectory)
print("FullTableName: ", fullTableName)

# Generate hash values for each row
# Add ETL Metadata Columns for each row. 
from datetime import datetime
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
from delta.tables import *

timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

sourceDf = spark.sql(sparkTableName)

exists = DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, targetTableFullPath)
hashColumns = [x for x in sourceDf.columns if x not in metadataColumns]

sourceDf = sourceDf.transform(with_4Fact_columns, naturalKeyColumnList, hashColumns, timestamp)

display(sourceDf.limit(5))

sqlQuery = "SELECT t.TransactionId, t.TypeEnum, t.CashierDate, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.CashierDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"yyyyMMdd\") AS CashierDateKey, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.CashierDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"HHmmss\") CashierTimeKey, \
t.CashierBy,u1.SK_User AS SK_UserCashierBy, date_format(to_timestamp(t.RecordDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"yyyyMMdd\") \
AS RecordDateKey, date_format(to_timestamp(t.RecordDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"HHmmss\") AS RecordTimeKey, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.VerifyDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"yyyyMMdd\") AS VerifyDateKey, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.VerifyDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"HHmmss\") AS VerifyTimeKey, \
sc1.SK_SourceCode, sc2.SK_SourceCode AS SK_SourceCodeReturnCode, a2.SK_Agent AS SK_AgentIncoming, \
a1.SK_Agent AS SK_AgentOutgoing, t.CreateBy, u2.SK_User AS SK_UserCreateBy, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.CreateDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"yyyyMMdd\") AS CreateDateKey, \
date_format(to_timestamp(t.CreateDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"HHmmss\") AS CreateTimeKey,t.CreateDate, \
u3.SK_User AS SK_UserModifyBy, date_format(to_timestamp(t.ModifyDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"yyyyMMdd\") \
AS ModifyDateKey, date_format(to_timestamp(t.ModifyDate, \"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss\"), \"HHmmss\") AS ModifyTimeKey, \
t.ModifyDate, t.IsERecord, t.NumberOfRecordableItems, t.BranchID, b.SK_Branch, CASE WHEN t.SourceCode = \
'Accounting' THEN sc2.SK_SourceCode ELSE sc1.SK_SourceCode END AS DeliveryMethod, 'Acclaim' AS VendorName \
FROM silver.acclaim_dbo_tbltransaction t \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_branch b ON b.BranchId = t.BranchId AND b.VendorName = 'Acclaim' \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_agent a1 ON a1.AgentId = t.OutgoingAgentId AND a1.VendorName = 'Acclaim'  \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_agent a2 ON a2.AgentId = t.IncomingAgentId AND a2.VendorName = 'Acclaim'  \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_user u1 ON u1.Username = t.CashierBy AND u1.ETLRowIsActive = 1 AND u1.VendorName = 'Acclaim' \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_user u2 ON u2.UserName = t.CreateBy AND u1.ETLRowIsActive = 1 AND u1.VendorName = 'Acclaim' \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_user u3 ON u3.UserName = t.ModifyBy AND u1.ETLRowIsActive = 1 AND u1.VendorName = 'Acclaim' \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_sourcecode sc1 ON sc1.Code = t.SourceCode AND sc1.VendorName = 'Acclaim' \
INNER JOIN gold.dim_sourcecode sc2 ON sc2.Code = t.ReturnCode AND sc2.VendorName = 'Acclaim'"

# Read target table, add Surrogate Key to Source Dataframe.
allColumns = [x for x in sourceDf.columns]

# If table exists, get surrogate key values for existing rows and generate surrogate key value for new rows
if exists:
    # If source table is incremental, only select rows which have been updated/new inserts.
    if isIncrementalLoad:
        targetDf = spark.sql(f"{sqlQuery} WHERE {incrementalColumn} >= '{maxDate}'")

    else:
        targetDf = spark.read.format("delta").load(targetTableFullPath)

    targetDf.createOrReplaceTempView('targetDf')   
    maxSK = spark.sql(f"SELECT MAX({surrogateKey}) AS LastSK FROM targetDf").first()[0]
    sourceDf = sourceDf.join(targetDf, how='left_anti', on=['ETLRowValueHash', 'ETLKeyHash'])
    sourceDf = sourceDf.alias('src').join(targetDf.alias('tgt'), on='ETLKeyHash', how='left').select(col(f"tgt.{surrogateKey}"), 'src.*')
    sourceDf = sourceDf.withColumn(surrogateKey, coalesce(surrogateKey, expr(f'ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ETLKeyHash) + {maxSK}')))
    sourceDf = sourceDf.select(col(surrogateKey), *allColumns)

# If table does not exist, generate surrogate key values for every row
else:
    sourceDf.createOrReplaceTempView("sourceTemp")
    sourceDf = spark.sql(f"SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ETLKeyHash) AS {surrogateKey} FROM sourceTemp")
    sourceDf = sourceDf.select(col(surrogateKey), *allColumns)
    
sourceDf.createOrReplaceTempView(stagingTableName)

# Setup the update field list to include all columns except ETLRowInsertedDatetime
updateTargetColumns = [x for x in sourceDf.columns if x not in ['ETLRowInsertedDatetime']]
updateSourceColumns = [f"src.{x}" for x in sourceDf.columns if x not in ['ETLRowInsertedDatetime']]
updateDictionary = dict(zip(updateTargetColumns, updateSourceColumns))

createQuery = """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {3}.{0} 
USING DELTA
LOCATION '{1}'
TBLPROPERTIES(delta.enableChangeDataFeed = True)
AS
SELECT * FROM {2} WHERE 1 = 0""".format(fullTableName, targetTableFullPath, stagingTableName, databaseName)

spark.sql(createQuery)

# Merge into target table
targetTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, targetTableFullPath)

(
    targetTable.alias('tgt') 
        .merge( 
            sourceDf.alias('src'),
            'tgt.ETLKeyHash = src.ETLKeyHash and tgt.ETLRowValueHash != src.ETLRowValueHash' 
        ) 
        .whenMatchedUpdate(set = updateDictionary
        )
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
        .execute()
